Town Council Opens New Library

The invented town of Brookvale opened its new public library on Monday morning. The building has three floors, a reading garden and a room for children's story hour.

The mayor said the library had taken four years to plan and build. Around two hundred people came to the opening, and many signed up for a library card on the first day.

The library will be open every day except Sunday. A small café on the ground floor will open next month, the council said.
